_source: Indonesian places: every location in Kemenag RI's (Bimas Islam) prayer schedule, named as Kemenag writes them, each with the reference point and Terbit/Maghrib sun altitude (h0) fitted to Kemenag's own published 2026 schedule (via api.myquran.com) with this engine's arithmetic, so computed times land on Kemenag's minutes. Six Papua highland regencies use Kemenag's Subuh 21 deg / Isya 19 deg there. Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah: Umm al-Qura, coordinates from en.wikipedia.org (Makkah = Masjidil Haram).
_fields: id (stable: saved in settings.json), label, kind (kota|kab|pulau|abroad; pulau = an island point inside a kab), prov (province or country), lat, lng (degrees), tz (IANA), h0 (sun altitude for Terbit and Maghrib, omitted = -1), subuh_angle / isya_angle (degrees below the horizon, omitted = 20 / 18), method (omitted = kemenag)
